On the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], a '''fighting master''' worked for the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Durrsk]]. The fighting master became a mentor to [[Tyrnia Masak]], who later killed Durrsk. The fighting master, a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], helped Masak escape.
